start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the markdown documents in a folder of my account's files as rows: each document's frontmatter is its fields, with the file's name, folder, size, dates, links, tags and identity, a page at a time", with the folder and the Namespace files your AI reads, given as stored.files (for example {"folder":"/Notes","stored":{"files":{"/Notes/plan.md":"..."}}}). It runs tool:read-namespace-documents-as-list-rows and answers {"rows":[{"id":"/Notes/plan.md","title":"plan","identity":"1f:a83a09f1c4b493836e2ef7ba4f403221e1e2309c337ab43769ec7ac01868c0ea","values":{"note.status":"draft","file.name":"plan.md","file.basename":"plan","file.ext":"md","file.path":"/Notes/plan.md","file.folder":"/Notes","file.size":53,"file.identity":"1f:a83a09f1c4b493836e2ef7ba4f403221e1e2309c337ab43769ec7ac01868c0ea","file.links":[] ...
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the files you hand in and keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the markdown documents in a folder of my account's files as rows: each document's frontmatter is its fields, with the file's name, folder, size, dates, links, tags and identity, a page at a time", and give it the files: your AI reads them from your Namespace and hands them in as stored.files; folder is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-namespace-documents-as-list-rows and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The same rows as tool:read-documents-as-list-rows, read from the Namespace files handed in as stored.files instead of a folder on their computer.
4. It reads only the files handed in and writes nothing.
